environment.description: Custom Terraform provider backend deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in us-east-1. The service is exposed on port 8443 and accepts JSON POST requests directly from Terraform CLI clients and CI/CD runners. No application-layer filtering is applied at the load balancer level. PostgreSQL RDS instance is in the same VPC with security group allowing inbound from the provider service. The provider backend handles state lookups for a multi-tenant Terraform Cloud alternative.

config.network: VPC with provider service SG allowing inbound TCP/8443 from 0.0.0.0/0
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, same VPC, SG allows inbound from provider service SG
config.auth: mTLS client certificates for Terraform CLI (validates workspace membership)
